name: @urlm/mobile
description: Android shell for Universal Router Manager — runs the portable engine host on the phone (Capacitor), no desktop bridge required.
author: Mohamed Ibrahim Abu El-Ezz

scripts.apk: npm run build -w @urlm/web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build -w @urlm/web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.typecheck: echo "@urlm/mobile: Android shell (Java) + Capacitor config — no TypeScript sources to type-check"
